An eight-year-old boy tragically lost his life after being run over by a speeding car in Mumbai’s Bandra West on Sunday afternoon. 💔

The incident reportedly took place near Jijamata Garden between 3:30 pm and 4 pm, when the child was crossing the road and was hit by a speeding car. He sustained critical injuries and was rushed to Holy Family Hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

The accused driver, identified as gym trainer Meghna Rawal, has been arrested by Bandra Police in connection with the incident. The tragic accident has once again raised concerns over road safety and speeding in busy residential areas. 🙏
